scope: YPerson release preparation; current primary Apple and AppMetrica sources only

sources.title: App Review Guidelines
decisions: Keep metadata, URLs, backend, reviewer access, and review notes complete and accurate.
Treat YPerson cards and audio as user-generated content requiring filtering, reporting, blocking, a public contact, and timely moderation responses.
Use fictional people in screenshots and answer age-rating questions honestly.

sources.title: App Review
decisions: Broken support/privacy links, placeholder content, incomplete submissions, and inaccessible backends remain release blockers.

sources.title: SDK minimum requirements for App Store submissions
decisions: From April 28, 2026, iOS uploads must use the iOS 26 SDK or later; installed Xcode 26.5 provides iOS SDK 26.5.

sources.title: Upload builds
decisions: A build upload must use registered bundle identifiers and unique version/build metadata; no upload is authorized in this stage.

sources.title: Distributing your app for beta testing and releases
decisions: Archive validation requires a real signed generic-device archive and Xcode Validate App; simulator or unsigned compilation cannot advance status.

sources.title: Create an App Store provisioning profile
decisions: Final explicit App IDs, distribution signing, entitlements, and profiles are required before archive validation.

sources.title: Configuring App Groups
decisions: The registered App Group must match the main app and widget provisioning entitlements.

sources.title: Privacy manifest files
decisions: Inspect each target and included SDK manifest, tracking domains, collected data, and required-reason APIs in the signed archive.

sources.title: Adding a privacy manifest to your app or third-party SDK
decisions: Invalid manifests can block submission; generate and inspect Xcode's privacy report from the final archive.

sources.title: Describing use of required reason API
decisions: Validate UserDefaults CA92.1 and AppMetrica FileTimestamp C617.1 declarations in their owning bundles.

sources.title: Third-party SDK requirements
decisions: Use Xcode dependency validation and inspect privacy manifests/signature continuity for all embedded third-party code in the final archive.

sources.title: Manage app privacy
decisions: A public privacy-policy URL and disclosures covering first- and third-party collection are mandatory.

sources.title: App privacy details
decisions: Exclude truly device-only data; conservatively map off-device collection, purpose, linkage, and ATT-dependent tracking for YPerson and AppMetrica.

sources.title: Offering account deletion in your app
decisions: The installation-scoped cloud profile requires an in-app full account deletion flow covering associated user-generated content.

sources.title: Screenshot specifications
decisions: Provide 1-10 PNG/JPEG screenshots without alpha; current 6.9-inch portrait sizes include 1260x2736, 1290x2796, and 1320x2868.

sources.title: Platform version information
decisions: Respect current limits for description, promotional text, keywords, support URL, review contact, and review notes.

sources.title: Age rating values and definitions
decisions: Answer current user-generated-content, advertising, and social-capability questions truthfully; record the generated rating only after App Store Connect calculates it.

sources.title: Export compliance documentation for encryption
decisions: YPerson uses TLS and Apple platform cryptography; set ITSAppUsesNonExemptEncryption to false, subject to confirming the final dependency inventory and App Store Connect questionnaire.

sources.title: iOS Quick Start
decisions: Keep exact SDK 6.5.0 and only Core, Crashes, and AdSupport products.

sources.title: App privacy in Apple services
decisions: Account for SDK privacy manifests, UserDefaults CA92.1, FileTimestamp C617.1, and AdSupport tracking domains; keep IDFA use behind ATT.

sources.title: iOS SDK changelog
decisions: Version 6.5.0 supports privacy manifests and disabling data sending; verify the exact resolved revision again in the final archive.

sources.title: AppMetrica Terms of Use
decisions: Production operator must confirm applicable consent, controller, credential-security, retention, and deletion obligations before release.

sources.title: AppMetrica Data Processing Agreement
decisions: Do not invent entity or territorial applicability; production privacy/legal owner must confirm the applicable DPA.
